about: Step 6, temp book staging/events.js (Mid's 37-events, 38-camps, 38-natives, 39-games): every piece, and what becomes of it. in v100: already home. bring: Mid has it, v100 does not; it comes in as book entries and laws with its feature (an events module, its numbers in the books). cut: v100 does it another way (most of Mid's climate: v100's floor 6). By the 10:31 rule, what comes over keeps Mid's values. The big table EV carries a line per row.

EVM: the multipliers the running event puts on damage, speed, sight and gathering; part of the event scheduler
KNOBS: which multipliers an event sets: heat (damage, speed); its eclipse entry is for a cut feature, see misfits
evmSet: sets the multipliers from the event now running
hz: whether a hazard is switched on (Easy keeps none); part of the hazards setting (v100 Later: Easy and Hard)
levelOf: the level played: the points of the hazards switched on
levelMul: the score's multiplier for the level played (QBR's total times it)
evOn: whether an event of a kind is running
edgeSpot: a spot on one of the land's edges, where an event comes in; to roll by v100's dice (QBF)
across: the far side of the land from a spot, through the middle
wildSpot: a free spot of land in the wild for an event
canEv: whether an event may come now (season, need, the fantasy switch)
pickEvent: picks the next event, not the same twice running
crossing: an event that crosses the map edge to edge in its time
herdAt: lays a herd of a kind at a spot (the stampede's bison)
EV: the table of events, one row a kind (rows below); the scheduler is new in v100 (an events module, its numbers in the books)

eclipse: (Albert to call: see misfits) the eclipse: a feature Albert cut (Nov 4); nothing comes over, see misfits
storm: (Albert to call: see misfits) v100's climate floor rolls storms (QH, D103) and lightning (KW6, QL); Mid's band of cloud walking east and its fires on wooden buildings, see misfits
stampede: a herd of bison runs across the map and tramples what it meets; their look is held as a skin in preview 49, the hooves sound waits in the Sound book
flood: (Albert to call: see misfits) the flood: held for later (KI4); nothing comes over now, see misfits
meteor: (Albert to call: see misfits) the falling star: held for later with the sky (KS3); nothing comes over now, see misfits
wildfire: a fire starts in far woods in summer or autumn and spreads tree to tree, damped by wetness (QT, Rothermel)
fog: (Albert to call: see misfits) v100's climate floor brings fog on a Poisson wait (KW7, QM, D110, D111); sight in fog (QK) is held
sinkhole: the ground gives way under a spot and harms the building there; its cracks are drawn
quicksand: a patch of ground that slows walkers to 0.3 for two minutes
heatwave: heat in a summer drought: blows 0.85, speed 0.9; see misfits
mirage: (Albert to call: see misfits) the mirage: a fantasy event Albert cut from v100's pull (Nov 4); nothing comes over, see misfits
circus: (Albert to call: see misfits) the circus: a fantasy event Albert cut from v100's pull (Nov 4); nothing comes over, see misfits
wagon: a wagon train crosses the map with a gift
mercs: mercenaries for hire appear at an edge as a find for a time
dragon: (Albert to call: see misfits) the dragon: a fantasy event Albert cut from v100's pull (Nov 4); nothing comes over, see misfits
troll: (Albert to call: see misfits) the troll: a fantasy event Albert cut from v100's pull (Nov 4); nothing comes over, see misfits
aurora: (Albert to call: see misfits) the aurora: held for later with the sky (KS2) and marked fantasy; nothing comes over now, see misfits

crackAt: the sinkhole's cracks on the ground, seeded from the place and the tick
startEvent: starts an event and says so
eventsTick: the scheduler, once a second: runs the event, waits, warns, starts the next
hordeTick: the horde (MH2): announced two seasons ahead, comes for the weakest side, grows with the age
blankClim: the climate's starting state; v100's K on the climate floor
airTemp: the air's temperature from the year's and the day's swing; v100's climate() does it from the season's mean (D100) and the day's swing (D101) by the light
wxWhy: why the sky turned, in the chain's own odds, shown under the news line
precip: whether the sky is falling rain or snow; v100's climate() knows what falls
skyTurn: the next sky from the chain (v100's climate() already rolls QH each game hour, D102); to bring: the sky rolled ahead for the Weather signs research, and the news line when it turns
climateTick: the climate's tick; v100's climate(dt) on floor 6
groundTick: wetness (QP), snow and its degree-day melt (QO), ice (QQ), mud; v100's climate() does each by the same laws (D104, D105, D107, D108, D109)
ruts: (Albert to call: see misfits) the ruts' counts a square; held for later (KI15), nothing comes over now, see misfits
rutsAt: (Albert to call: see misfits) the ruts at a place; held for later (KI15), nothing comes over now, see misfits
rutsOn: (Albert to call: see misfits) a step deepens the ruts; held for later (KI15), nothing comes over now, see misfits
rutHeal: (Albert to call: see misfits) the ruts dry back with time; held for later (KI15), nothing comes over now, see misfits
rutOf: (Albert to call: see misfits) rut depth as passes^0.4 (QS); held for later (KI15), nothing comes over now, see misfits
mudAt: (Albert to call: see misfits) the mud at a place: v100's footing (QN, D106) reads the wet and the marsh; Mid's extra by the shore (pooling, KI3) and the ruts (KI15) are held, see misfits
groundNeed: the grip a step needs, by foot, horse or engine (Hanson 1999); part of slipping on ice (QR), see misfits
studded: whether iron bites the ice (Horseshoes, Crampons research)
iceMu: the ice's friction now, slickest just under freezing; studs give theirs; see misfits
strideShare: the stride lost on ice by the grip a step lacks
groundSpd: what the ground takes off a march; v100's footing (QN, D106) already slows by mud and snow; to bring: the ice's lost stride, the wagon's wheels in mud, research on mud and snow
muOf: the friction the ground offers at a place, a blend of ice, snow, mud, dry; v100's Ground book holds friction (G) for QBT's slide
slipChance: the chance of a slip on ice (QR, logistic); see misfits
rothermel: Rothermel's damping of fire by wetness (QT, already a v100 law); comes with fire
fireMul: fire's spread by the ground's wetness now; comes with fire (wildfire, fire arrows)
wearMul: blades go brittle in frost and rust in rain unless researched (Tempering, Oiling)
newsTick: the age's news lines every so often
herdTick: a crossing herd: bison trample, performers pass, a dragon flies; the performers and the dragon are cut fantasy, see misfits
starveTick: hunger and famine: with no food in reach the work weakens, under the Famine hazard people leave; v100's upkeep (QBP) only stops the store at nothing (hungry sides parked)
foodInReach: whether a side still has food it can walk to
CAMP_TENTS: the four camp tents (BTC5 Medical, BTC6 Training, BTC7 Mess, BI5 Depot); part of the war camps (BTC3, BTC4)
campLayout: a camp's pieces: the Outpost a strip, the Camp a square with palisade, gate, towers, tents (Hyginus)
campFacing: a camp faces home (its gate side)
campWhy: why a camp cannot stand at a spot
campUnpack: the Camp wagon (UT2) unpacks: trees under it burn, felled trees laid as abatis (BF5), the pieces become sites
wagonTick: the Camp wagon drives to its spot and unpacks
campCap: how many camps a side may have out (one, two from the next age; the Camp wagons research and a Store)
campsOut: the camps a side has out, wagons on the road counted
campWhyTrain: why a Camp wagon cannot be trained
canRaise: a foot soldier idle near its camp's unraised piece lends a hand
campRaise: soldiers raise and mend their camp at a villager's rate
campSendHome: the badly hurt and sick by a medical tent walk home to the Hospital
depotNear: the depot a unit eats from
campEat: soldiers in a depot's reach eat from it; unsupplied they slow and do not mend
supplyRun: a Market caravan runs food to a depot under half, for a carter's fee in gold
campWearTick: rain, snow and frost wear a camp's pieces each minute
homeOf: where a side or group is found: the Natives at the Throne, a gang at its camp, a side at its Town Center
natState: the Natives' own state: the handover, the raids, the garrison's regrowth
gangState: each group's regard for each side, its stance, its gifts; part of diplomacy (Later, kept)
regardOf: a group's regard for a side (0 to 100)
addRegard: regard rises or falls, and the stance follows
gangSet: a side's stance with a group is set; the Natives' gates open to a friend
gangSync: peace and war follow regard; an alliance needs an emissary
giftGain: each gift buys less regard than the last (Danegeld)
giftWhy: why a gift cannot be given
giveGift: a gift of gold for regard
judgeGang: a group answers an emissary (the Natives' answer copied for every misfit group; their own rules are parked)
gunAge: whether any side has reached the Gunpowder age (the Natives' garrison thins)
garrisonMax: the Throne's garrison size by the ages; see misfits
natSpawn: a Native warrior or bowman comes out at the Throne; see misfits
throneHold: how long the Throne must be held, by the match's length; see misfits
takeThrone: the Throne changes hands, walls and towers with it; see misfits
trapAt: lays a hidden trap (BF1 Pit, BF2 Net, BF3 Stakes, BF4 Caltrops)
layTraps: the Natives keep traps on each causeway to the Throne; see misfits
trapsTick: traps spring on foes, scouts find them, allies walk free, caltrops wear flat
natRaid: outlaw raids (MH3 Robbers): a band at the side they regard least, the mark drawn by load and guard (QAR, square law)
nativesTick: the Natives' beat: traps, raids, regard's memory, the Throne's handover and score
PEACE: the peace path's numbers: truce price, standing down, the Games, the hidden age after a year of peace, the crowns
CARE: what counts as care for the Wellbeing crown (Hospital, Temple, Baths, Theatre, Tavern)
bestOf: the best a side has of a measure over its soldier kinds (for the Games)
livingSides: the living sides; v100 reads D.players and the Seat (econ.js)
truceAll: a board truce: no two living sides at war
truceFor: seconds the whole board has kept the peace
ageOpen: the hidden age (Enlightenment) opens once, for every side
nextAge: a side's next age, if open; v100 econ.js ageCost and ageUp walk the ages but know no hidden one
chron: the chronicle: the match's lines, kept to a count
peaceTick: once a second: the truce clock, the hidden age, standing down, the Games
standDown: at peace, soldiers above the keep share go home as villagers
holdGames: the Games under a board truce, won on the square of each side's best; held on the Throne island, see misfits
crownsOf: the three crowns: Wealth, War, Wellbeing, and the overall
CROWN_NAME: the crowns' names (to the Words book)
crownsHTML: the crowns card and the chronicle, paged
enlightenTick: the last research of the hidden age ends the match for everyone
chaseCrown: a computer's personality chases its crown (beyond balanced: Later, kept)

misfits: EV.eclipse, KNOBS
The eclipse event is still in Mid's table. You cut the eclipse. It stays behind, right?
EV.mirage, EV.circus, EV.dragon, EV.troll, herdTick
These are the fantasy events you cut from v100 (dragon, troll, mirage, circus). They stay behind, right?
EV.aurora
Mid has a northern lights event at night (marked fantasy). In v100 the aurora is part of the sky, held until there is a horizon to show it. Leave it out?
EV.storm

Mid's storm is a band of cloud walking across the map, and lightning in it sets wooden buildings on fire. v100 already has storms and lightning from the weather, and fire from a strike is held for later. Drop Mid's storm band and keep the fires waiting?
EV.flood
Mid's flood raises the lake and damages buildings near it. Flooding is held for later in v100. Hold this with it?
EV.meteor
Mid's falling star lands a find (stone) in the wild. Meteors are held for later with the sky. Hold this too, or bring it as a ground event only?
EV.heatwave
The heat wave slows everyone to 0.9 of their speed. Walking is fixed at 3.4 mph. Should heat slow people at all?
ruts, rutsAt, rutsOn, rutHeal, rutOf, mudAt
Mid has ruts that deepen where feet go and make the mud worse, and mud deeper by the shore. Ruts and pooling are held for later in v100. Hold them?
iceMu, muOf, slipChance, groundNeed, strideShare, studded
In Mid, wet ground freezes and walkers slip and lose stride on it. In v100 only lakes freeze (they can be walked on), and frost is held for later. Should ice on the ground come over now?
throneB, garrisonMax, natSpawn, throneHold, takeThrone, layTraps, holdGames

Mid's Throne stands on an island in the great lake in the middle, with Native guards, traps on the causeways, and the Games held there. You said the middle stays clear until you describe the reimagined Throne. Do these wait for that?
